unknowns: Current official UC Merced EECS directory and first-person page confirm Assistant Professor and rossgreer@ucmerced.edu; personal news states joined 2024. No faculty identity inference from names or photos.

The graduate-degree section currently excludes PhD applicants needing lab funding and routes MS/PhD applicants through Graduate Division. The separate visiting-researcher section is the relevant route; its self-funding expectation is not university immigration approval.

The one-year minimum applies to UC Merced undergraduate researchers, not the distinct outside-visitor section. Neither an eight-week minimum/maximum nor summer 2027 dates, remote format or mentoring capacity is promised.
The 2025 Aalborg visitor spent a semester; it is not an eight-week precedent. Current alumni status is consistent with a completed visit, not a current vacancy.

The February 2026 VLA paper operates entirely on nuScenes/doScenes data. Its10-step predictions and measured ADE are open-loop; around20minutes per clip is not real-time control. Closed-loop safety and recovery remain unverified.

The June 2026 work-zone system explicitly separates perception from actuation. Recorded-data performance and onboard deployment do not establish automatic speed enforcement or learned navigation. Physical10 is limited hardware/perception credit, not robot-policy validation; the news RoboRacer cannot fill the missing method link.
